facts.fact: 牧场共识：一个牛仔的孩子是所有人的孩子。
facts.anchor: Emmy Jean might be Harriet’s kid; Brooks’s niece and Silas and Josie’s granddaughter, but on this ranch, one cowboy’s baby is everyone’s baby.

facts.fact: 她小时候有自己的布偶 Macy（cowgirl ragdoll），遗落在 Miss Celia 餐馆桌上，Mr. Hart 一小时内送回还带了盒装派。
facts.anchor: Mr. Hart showed up less than an hour later, with Macy in one hand and a thick slice of pie boxed up in the other.

facts.fact: 她回忆 Declan：九十年代刺猬头男团发型与可爱的细金属框眼镜。
facts.anchor: Of his 1990s spiky boyband hair and his adorable, wire-rimmed glasses.

facts.fact: 两人相识于咖啡店：她把咖啡泼上他的衬衫，他大笑并买新咖啡给她。
facts.anchor: We met in a coffee house, where he quite literally bumped into me and I spilled my coffee on him.

facts.fact: Declan 是纽约软件工程师，住 Hudson Yards，意大利皮鞋、法餐术语说得毫不违和。
facts.anchor: a software engineer in New York City, a man who rarely had to leave his Hudson Yards loft

facts.fact: 她咬下纽约苹果尝到甜味——直到苹果把她毒倒。
她在 Autumn Sage 与 Whiteleaf Mountain mint 之间的灌木丛里找到 Bunny。
facts.anchor: right between a patch of Autumn Sage and Whiteleaf Mountain mint

facts.fact: Bunny 找到后群聊庆祝：Jody 宣布解散搜索队、Brooks 约在 Harriet 家碰头。
facts.anchor: STAND DOWN MEN bunny been found

facts.fact: 看着大块头为孩子融化成软泥让她身体反应强烈——到 Brooks 更是另一回事。
facts.anchor: There’s something about an enormous man turning into a pile of mush for a little kid that sends my ovaries into overdrive.

facts.fact: 深夜独处释放到顶点时喊出的名字是 Brooks——他可能已俘虏她的心将近二十年。
facts.anchor: The name that falls from my lips is the one that belongs to an enormous cowboy with a shit-eating grin.

relations: Silas 与 Josie 是 Brooks 的父母（Emmy 的祖父母）
Macy 是她童年的布偶、Mr. Hart 是归还者
Declan 是咖啡店相遇的软件工程师，后成为三人关系一方
Garlic 是驮她找 Bunny 的年轻马
